player_prompt.intro:
Oli Player {player_id} mu mizannyo ya Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma egenda mu {num_rounds} mizannyo.

Muundo gw'Omuzanyo:
- Nga wakati wa kulonda, olina {total_conversation_rounds} mizunguko ya kuyogera ky'oyagala.
- Oluvanyuma, bazannya bombi bwe bwereere balyoke bafuuse kuwa wamu oba baleme.

Matirikiro ga Payoff (tegekeddwa buli muzanyo):
- Bombi Bafuuse Wamu ➜ buli {cooperate_reward}
- Bombi Baleme ➜ buli {mutual_defect_reward}
- Omuntu Omulema, omulala Afuuse Wamu ➜ Omulema {defect_reward}, Omuwamu {sucker_reward}

Engeri ya Kuzannya:
- Nga wakati wa kuyogera: andika ky'oyagala.
- Nga wakati wa kulonda: weka '[Cooperate]' oba '[Defect]' (si ya kisawaziso). Oyinza kuongeza ebigambo ebirala ku ntandikwa/ku mukono gwa token.

phases.conversation_finished: Okukubagana kwakkulu kwa mzunguko {round}. Tandika '[Cooperate]' or '[Defect]' mu {{}} eddibba.
